newsitem.title: USA: PECO exercises warrant for 4.99 pct Great Bay.
newsitem.headline: PECO exercises warrant for 4.99 pct Great Bay.

text.p: Great Bay Power Corp said on Monday that PECO Energy Co had exercized its warrant to buy 417,000 shares, or 4.99 percent, of Great Bay common stock for $9.75 per share.

The exercize of the warrant extends an agreement between PECO and Great Bay, allowing PECO to remain exclusive marketing agent for power generated from Great Bay's 12.1 percent interest in the Seabrook Nuclear Power Plant until December 31, 1998, Great Bay said.

Great Bay said PECO paid $1 million in November 1995 to buy the warrant. Under the warrant terms, $1 million will be credited toward the purchase of 417,800 newly-issued shares of Great Bay. The company said it will receive $3.1 million in additional cash as a result of PECO's exercize of the warrant.
